title: Case 006: Two Similar Transfers
initial_request: Mira, the account holder, wants H&V to establish whether two similar outgoing transfer entries are one instruction shown twice or two separate instructions, and asks whether the second can be stopped or returned.
overview: Mira saw two similar entries to the same utility payee for the same amount in her secure portal and escalated because she intended to make only one transfer. H&V checked the independent references for her own payment instructions and confirmed there were two separate instructions with different statuses.

next_action.summary: At escalation, compare the number and independent references of Mira’s payment instructions in H&V’s journal before advising or making any change.

outcome: H&V confirmed two separate payment instructions: one completed and one pending. No cancellation or return of the second instruction was initiated.

events.body: Your payment activity shows two similar outgoing transfer entries to North Quay Utilities for £84.20. One is marked Completed and the other Pending.
I own this account and only meant to make one transfer. Please check whether these are separate instructions, and whether the pending one has been stopped or returned.
I’m checking the count and independent instruction references for Mira’s own payment instructions before advising. I have not cancelled or returned either instruction.
Journal match: two distinct instruction references for the same payee and amount. One instruction is Completed; the other is Pending.

I’ve confirmed these are two separate payment instructions, not one instruction duplicated in the display. One is Completed and the other is Pending; I have not cancelled or initiated a return for the pending instruction.
